As noted, this script must be modified to use `flux run` instead of a generic MPI launcher like `mpirun` to correctly utilize the 24 tasks allocated across the node. Failure to do so will result in incorrect execution and wasted resources.
The script is highly non-portable due to hardcoded, user-specific absolute paths for the working directory and libraries.
